Everything On Offer

Designed for how you actually live

Nine things you get by living at Ridgewood. Filter by where you will find them — inside your home, in the building, or out on the grounds.

9 amenities

Utilities Included

Heat, water, trash, and sewer are all covered by your rent. Electric is the only bill you set up.

On-Site Parking

Resident parking steps from your own entrance, with garages available.

Private Balconies

Most homes open onto a private balcony or patio overlooking the courtyard lawn.

Laundry on Every Floor

Newly installed machines in an easily accessible room, all credit card operated — no coins to keep track of.

On-Site Management

A leasing team on the property every weekday for maintenance requests and questions.

Heat & Air Conditioning

Central heat, plus air conditioning available, keeping every home comfortable year-round.

Secure Entry

Locked building entrances with intercom access for your guests.

Classic Kitchens

Warm wood cabinetry and timeless finishes give every kitchen its own character.

Oak Courtyard Grounds

Mature oaks and maintained lawns between the buildings, cared for through every season.

Included In Your Rent

Four of the five bills, already handled

  • ✓Heat
  • ✓Water
  • ✓Trash
  • ✓Sewer
  • –Electric

Heat, water, trash and sewer are covered by your rent. Electric is the only account you open in your own name — which makes budgeting for a month here a good deal simpler than most places you will look at.
